leakage_controls: 2122 warm-up rows are excluded from Route A evidence
GAP lambda selection is nested before each target season
same-kickoff GAP fixtures are predicted from a shared pre-batch state before any same-time updates are applied
calibration method selection uses only dedicated calibration seasons and never outer test outcomes
dataset_summary.point_in_time_contract: Route A uses only batched pre-kickoff Day 7 GAP replays with target-season-specific historical lambda selection.

provenance_summary.as_of_policy_description: Prediction-row as_of is the latest source-backed pre-match timestamp the replayed prediction is allowed to depend on. Because the historical source exposes fixture date plus kickoff time but no finer observation timestamp for the football-process inputs used here, persist as_of as the fixture kickoff timestamp when kickoff_time is present, otherwise the conservative day-start timestamp match_dateT00:00:00. This preserves the rule that historical pre-match as_of never exceeds kickoff.
provenance_summary.baseline_policy_description: For each competition/statistic, estimate home and away baselines from the earliest readiness-approved season only. Process that season chronologically as warm-up, then start evaluation on later seasons with no future-season leakage.
provenance_summary.lambda_selection_policy_description: For each competition/statistic, test the fixed lambda grid chronologically on pre-holdout validation folds. Rank candidates by aggregate validation combined MAE, then by lower absolute home/away bias sum, then by lower lambda. Retain the 0.05 reference lambda unless the best non-reference candidate improves combined MAE by at least the fixed material threshold.

validation.outer_test_model_selection_guard: Calibration selection uses only dedicated calibration seasons inside each fold, so outer test outcomes cannot influence the chosen deployment method.
